items.headline: Retatrutide beats Ozempic head to head in type 2 diabetes
items.summary: In a phase three trial, Lilly's retatrutide lowered blood sugar more than semaglutide and produced about 21 percent weight loss versus 9 percent over 80 weeks.
items.why_it_matters: A more effective treatment could help many of the hundreds of millions of people living with type 2 diabetes.
